name: of1-skills
description: Integrate OF1 (generative-search) into an existing Adobe Edge Delivery Services project: verify prerequisites, extract/reuse design tokens, generate templates and CTA config, style the generative block, and publish. Runs standalone against any EDS/Stardust repo — no demo-building or site-crawling steps.

_notes.entrypoints: of1-integration is the standalone entry point — invoke it directly against an existing EDS repo. It is a driver (run from a top-level context) that dispatches every other skill in this plugin per its own step graph (see of1-integration/SKILL.md) and writes of1-integration-result.json. of1-check-dependencies is its own step 1.
